findings.why: BR-310 belongs only to PRG-Y (Nordhavn). Moving the coating step to the new Pinerolo line moves production to another site. CSR-NOR-R2 treats that as a change of source, which needs Nordhavn approval (PPAP) before first shipment. No approval in force covers it. BR-310 is not an Aurelia part, so no Aurelia finding applies.
